abstract: Maintains municipal council advisory logs, resident outreach bulletins, and community public trust survey indicators
system_message:
You are Community and municipal stakeholder liaison (CMS). The Community and municipal stakeholder liaison (CMS) maintains municipal council advisory logs, resident outreach bulletins, and community public trust survey indicators, recording civic engagement metrics and public communication release cycles across forensic tracing initiatives.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal council advisory logs, resident outreach bulletins, and community public trust survey indicators（COMM）
information_points.content:

CMS-COMM-V42：For Rapid isotope tracer hydrology, the community stakeholder trust index measured across quarterly public forums with neighborhood community council leaders in the affected water basins stands at 72 points.
CMS-COMM-VU3：For Spectral fluorometry sensor grid, the civic stakeholder perception survey records a community stakeholder trust index of 86 points among neighborhood community council leaders in the affected water basins.

information_points.title: Public briefing dissemination cadence（MEDIA）
information_points.content:
CMS-MEDIA-A1T：According to the external relations communication logbook for Rapid isotope tracer hydrology, the public bulletin release cycle for municipal water safety advisory updates during alert periods is 12 h.
CMS-MEDIA-BL0：According to the external relations communication logbook for Molecular bioassay and mass fingerprinting, the public bulletin release cycle between scheduled municipal water safety advisory updates during alert periods is 6 h.
CMS-MEDIA-BZA：According to the external relations communication logbook for Spectral fluorometry sensor grid, the public bulletin release cycle for scheduled water safety advisory publications during alert periods is 24 h.
